verdict.summary: Moderate distance: about two weeks of short, careful threads, not a rebuild. Four backend files of 2,200-2,800 lines; three of them do five or six jobs each. One decision from Scott (N0) unlocks most of the remaining split work.
topReasons: People are written in five live places (plus two dead copies); F15 was in one copy.
Privacy guards are source-text checks at fixed file paths; several assert absence between two function names and would pass vacuously after a move.
One idea, several names: 'operations' has three meanings, 'connections' two, and there are two queues, with no name map.

census.method: git ls-files; line count of every tracked text file (final line without newline counts); binaries excluded. Classes: generated-or-data = convex/_generated, pnpm-lock.yaml, .json/.yaml/.yml/.toml, fixture files; stylesheet = .css; test = *.test.*, *.spec.*, tests/, scripts/test-*; hand-written = remaining .ts/.tsx/.js/.mjs/.cjs/.sh/.py; docs = .md/.html.
notes: Dense files that behave like 1,500-line files: components/queue/QueueWorkspace.tsx (773 lines, 52 KB, longest line 1,108), components/vault/StoryReviewView.tsx (554, 40 KB, longest 3,025), components/vault/PersonWorkspaceView.tsx (574, 37 KB), lib/mcp/catalog.ts (528, 32 KB, longest 2,230). AIR-09 (formatter) addresses these.
